subject: Fraud & Scams
title: How Pyramid Schemes Spread
description: One-minute skill: How Pyramid Schemes Spread.

hook.text: Join for $100, recruit two friends, and earn $200. Sounds fair — until you do the math.

buildup.text: Each level of the pyramid must be bigger than the last. Growth is mandatory, not optional.

discovery.text: By level 13, the pyramid needs more participants than Earth's population.

twist.text: Only the top few levels profit. Everyone at the bottom — the vast majority — loses everything.

climax.text: Roughly 99% of pyramid scheme participants lose money. The math is merciless.

punchline.text: The pyramid always has a top and a bottom. You're at the bottom.

quiz.question: What percentage of pyramid scheme participants typically lose money?
